cases.headline: Start Nacua and Bowers; retain Lamb only if available
cases.uiSummary:
Decision in brief
Recommendation

Tentative choice · Josh Allen, James Cook, Jonathan Taylor, Puka Nacua, CeeDee Lamb, Brock Bowers, Chris Olave.

Expected change

Selected lineup compared with recorded starters: 16.9 points. Conditional on supplied estimates; not a realized gain.

Strongest alternative

If Lamb is inactive, use Wilson at WR and retain Olave at FLEX. Wilson's weekly estimate is 14.63 points/week versus Lamb's conditional 18.55 points/week. Credible evidence of restricted usage could also favor Wilson, but no supplied evidence quantifies that restriction. The displayed optimized total would no longer apply to this fallback lineup.

Stale evidence, uncertain injury availability, an unconfirmed waiver drop or a statistical estimate without prospective validation supports a tentative comparison rather than a firm recommendation.
